issuing_body: U.S. District Court, District of Minnesota
title: United States v. Bock et al. (Abdi Nur Salah) - Plea Agreement, ECF 497
supports: Abdi Nur Salah agrees to forfeit $343,418.98 seized from a Star Choice Credit Union account and consents to a money judgment forfeiture of $1,063,255, with credit for the net value of forfeited property.
He agrees he owes restitution of $1,063,255.
does_not_support: A plea agreement states agreed amounts; it is not a restitution order or a forfeiture order, and no judgment for this defendant is captured.
Seized property is credited against the money judgment; the figures must not be summed.
